data.name: HOLOSYDE
data.detailed_description:
HOLOSYDE is in early development. This page shares the vision and direction for the game -
wishlist to follow its progress. 


Enter the dark, atmospheric world of HOLOSYDE, a hard-hitting retro PvE FPS that strips away modern bloat to deliver pure, adrenaline-fueled action wrapped in modern, AAA visuals. Combining old-school level design with modern gunplay, HOLOSYDE is a visceral shooter built for fans of classic PC action.

Key Features

  • Next-Gen Retro Aesthetics: Experience a striking visual contrast where highly realistic, AAA environments meet holographic weapons and characters. Immerse yourself in a dark sci-fi world where claustrophobic corridors, large arenas and moody lighting set the tone

  • Visual Contrast: High-fidelity, realistic, AAA sci-fi environments contrasted with glitching, holographic weapons, power-ups and characters

  • Relentless Enemy AI: Enemies track you actively through claustrophobic corridors, prioritizing constant movement and precise gameplay over cover mechanics

  • Co-op & Solo: Take on the campaign alone or team up online with friends

  • Classic Design: Fast-paced action focused on tight controls, without microtransactions or forced RPG mechanics

data.short_description: HOLOSYDE is a fast-paced retro PvE FPS blending classic gameplay with modern, AAA visuals. Realistic environments contrast with holographic, glitching weapons and characters. From claustrophobic corridors to open arenas, tear through dozens of enemies in this brutal homage to classic shooters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K / AMD Ryzen 5 7600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game features stylized, non-realistic combat. Enemies are destroyed with glitch/holographic visual effects rather than realistic gore or blood. No sexual content.
